lead.title: Chip stocks enter bear market as AI trade shifts
lead.summary: AI chip stocks entered a bear market as the market rotated away from high-flying semiconductor names, triggered by Chinese AI model breakthroughs and valuation concerns. Apple reclaimed the world's most valuable company title at $4.9 trillion as capital flowed out of hardware and into consumer tech.

top_stories.title: South Korea's $518 billion AI chip bet reshaping global markets and pulling capital from crypto
top_stories.summary: South Korea announced a massive $518 billion AI chip investment plan that is reshaping global semiconductor supply chains and diverting capital from cryptocurrency markets.

top_stories.title: Toyota and Nvidia expand AI partnership across vehicles, factories and cities
top_stories.summary: Toyota and Nvidia expanded their partnership to develop AI for autonomous vehicles, smart factories, and city infrastructure using NVIDIA's AI computing platforms.

top_stories.title: Chinese AI chipmaker Biren unveils optical supernodes to match Nvidia
top_stories.summary: Chinese AI chip startup Biren Technology disclosed plans for light-based 'supernodes' using silicon photonics interconnects, aiming to compete with Nvidia in AI inference at scale.

top_stories.title: Etched targets $20 billion valuation with back-to-back rounds as inference chip demand hits $1 billion
top_stories.summary: AI inference chip startup Etched is targeting a $20 billion valuation following consecutive funding rounds, as demand for specialized inference silicon reaches $1 billion.

items.title: US Startup Tests Humanoid AI Robot Soldiers in Ukraine
items.summary: Foundation Future Industries is preparing Phantom humanoid AI robots for military combat, with machines already tested in Ukraine. Lethal capabilities may follow as both the US and China accelerate humanoid combat robot development.

items.title: Fable 5 vs GPT-5.6-Sol: Breakdown of Key Architectural Differences
items.summary: Theo breaks down the biggest differences between Fable and GPT-5.6-Sol, currently the two largest and most capable AI models, comparing their architectures and performance characteristics.

items.title: Apple unseats Nvidia to become world's most valuable company amid AI market shift
items.summary: Apple reclaimed the title of world's most valuable company at $4.9 trillion, surpassing Nvidia as AI chip stocks entered a correction and investors rotated into consumer tech.

items.title: Fujitsu partners with Fanuc, Yaskawa and Kawasaki to advance physical AI using Nvidia technology
items.summary: Fujitsu partnered with Fanuc, Yaskawa, and Kawasaki Robotics to advance physical AI for industrial automation, leveraging NVIDIA's robotics and AI platforms.

items.title: NVIDIA released DeepStream 9.1: bringing agentic AI to vision AI with 13 skills and multi-view 3D tracking
items.summary: NVIDIA released DeepStream 9.1, adding 13 agentic AI skills, Multi-View 3D Tracking, and AutoMagicCalib for natural-language multi-camera vision AI pipelines.

items.title: AI sparks memory capacity crunch; Taiwanese firms reap windfall from order shifts
items.summary: Memory capacity shortages driven by AI demand are creating a windfall for Taiwanese semiconductor firms, with significant order shifts from traditional to AI-specific memory products.

items.title: Palm Garden AI develops Coherence Guard relational decision layer for human-facing robots
items.summary: Palm Garden AI introduced Coherence Guard, a relational decision layer designed to improve safety and coherence in human-facing robots by enforcing logical constraints during inference.

items.title: Transcribe.cpp — C++ speech recognition tool hits 231 points on HN as a practical offline transcription tool
items.summary: A fast, local speech recognition tool written in C++ that reached 231 points on Hacker News as a practical tool for offline transcription.

items.title: Talon — self-hosted harness for long-lived AI agents with MCP tool access
items.summary: Multi-platform agentic AI harness running on Telegram, Discord, Teams and Terminal with pluggable backends (Claude, Kilo, OpenCode, Codex, OpenAI Agents) and full MCP tool access.

items.title: PodStack — GPU slicing without Nvidia MIG, works on AMD too
items.summary: Full-stack GPU cloud platform allowing fractional GPU slicing without Nvidia MIG, with AMD support. Launches, trains, serves, and operates AI models on shared GPU infrastructure.

items.title: Codex Resets — service monitoring Codex agent reset cycles
items.summary: A tracking service that monitors and displays when Codex (Anthropic's coding agent) resets, providing visibility into agent lifecycle and stability.

items.title: Fosnie — open-source self-hosted AI workspace for regulated teams
items.summary: Self-hosted private AI platform that runs where your data lives, designed for regulated teams needing data sovereignty. Open-source and deployable on-prem.
